comments.text: Oh shit, i didn’t see this comic until now… This is how my entire career feels, so high five for not being welcome in rooms (or the inaccurate perception of thus).

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.text: Thanks guys! I love being linked to reddit; I love people seeing the comics who normally wouldn’t and I love the comments, particularly the negative ones. No one’s going to take the time to post negative comments directly to your site. It’s nice to see why people don’t like the comics. And it’s super nice to hear why they do when they do. But r/comics. It’s like no one even clicks the link to read it and then hate it. It just slides awkwardly down to oblivion. It’s so disheartening.
